title: White model portraits verified with visible logos
summary: Verified the Homme and Femme white-background cards in mobile and desktop component previews.

changes.detail: Optimized WebP model portraits edited with built-in imagegen. Prompt: change only concrete scenery to white, preserve the same models, pose, clothing and exact chest logo lettering, colors, underline and placement.

Homme/Femme defaults now use white portraits, including old printed-v3 default references. Portrait-specific framing reserves white caption space and uses existing dark-green text treatment. Custom uploads remain supported.
Reserve top space on mobile portraits so article-count badges do not cover model faces.

validation.name: Responsive browser fixtures
validation.detail: Rendered actual CategoryTiles component in Chrome at 375, 482 and 1280px with fixture categories/counts. All four white assets load, overlays are absent, dark captions and category destinations are correct. Mobile/desktop screenshots inspected; model logos remain visible.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: Direct ESLint check of components/CategoryTiles.tsx passed.

validation.name: Learning app typecheck and history tests
validation.detail: npm run typecheck passed; all four change-history tests passed.

validation.name: Live integration and deployment
validation.detail: Isolated component verification only, not live API or full storefront validation. No deployment performed.
